# Progress

Communicates progress with an accessible name. React's `value` is measured against `max` (100 by default), and the visual fill and announced value use the same scale. Use `null` or omit `value` when progress is indeterminate.

- **Import:** `import { Progress } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Feedback
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/feedback-progress--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Progress, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ProgressExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Progress aria-label="Download progress" value={66} className="w-3/5" />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Progress

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<ProgressPrimitive.ProgressProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `value`: `number | null`, optional.
- `max`: `number`, optional, default `100`.
- `getValueLabel`: `(value: number, max: number) => string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
